constraint: 经六路农业路至黄河路段全线封闭；花园路政七街至黄河路段完全封闭；经三路向南严重拥堵；经八路向北正常通行。

protocol.planning_time_definition: Planning Time (s) = model inference time + route solving time only. It excludes SUMO startup, warm-up, simulation stepping, and live vehicle travel.
protocol.travel_time_definition: Travel Time (s) = SUMO trip duration for the evaluated vehicle only, measured from vehicle depart to vehicle arrival inside the simulator.

legacy_field_notes.time_s: Legacy seconds field that was often used for inference or planning time, depending on the script.
legacy_field_notes.infer_time: Model inference-only time; this is a subcomponent of planning time, not travel time.
legacy_field_notes.sumo_time: SUMO-measured vehicle travel time in seconds.
legacy_field_notes.travel_time: SUMO-measured vehicle travel time in seconds in the current app pipeline.
legacy_field_notes.true_travel_time: Legacy analytical proxy from evaluate.py rather than a live SUMO trip duration.
